channel.title: Hack the Platform Blog
channel.description: Insights, tutorials, and stories about Microsoft Power Platform and beyond. Empower your business with Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Agents, and more.

item.title: Block Copilot Studio in Default Environment with a Simple Plugin
item.description: Learn how to prevent users from creating Copilot agents in the Default Power Platform environment using a simple Dataverse plugin.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Custom API: Run Complex FetchXML Queries from Canvas App
item.description: Learn how to run complex FetchXML queries directly from a Canvas App using a Dataverse POST Custom API. This tutorial shows you how to bypass Power Automate Flows, build a signed plugin DLL, register a POST Custom API, and parse the results into JSON for dynamic use in your Canvas Apps. Ideal for advanced Power Platform developers who want more efficient, flexible, and secure ways to retrieve aggregated data across multiple tables.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Auto-Generate Azure Blob Folders from Dataverse Using a Plugin
item.description: Learn how to create a Dataverse plugin that automatically creates Azure Blob Storage folders for new records using REST API calls.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)
